On June 6th, 2001, a Chinese businessman, Mr. CHOW LIU, deposited in his personal safety deposit vault currency valued at £17,500,000.00 (Seventeen Million, Five Hundred Thousand British Pound Sterling) in my client's branch. Upon expiration of the period of leasehold of his safety deposit vault two years ago, my client sent a routine notification to his forwarding address but got no reply. Some months ago, a reminder was sent, and finally it was discovered he had passed away. On further investigation, it was discovered that he did not leave a WILL and all attempts to trace his next of kin were fruitless. Further investigations revealed that Mr. CHOW LIU did not declare any next-of- kin in all his official documents in my clients' bank. This sum of £17,500,000.00 is still in the Vault which was opened, and the keys changed upon the expiration of the period of leasehold by my clients. Consequently, my proposal is that my clients will like you as a foreigner to stand in as the next of kin to Mr. CHOW LIU. This is simple. I will like you to provide me immediately with your full names and address so that by virtue of my position as an attorney, I will prepare the necessary documents and affidavits, which will put you in place as the next of kin. I shall do the drafting and notarization of the WILL and obtain the necessary documents and letter of probate/administration in your favor from the shipment of the funds through a courier company to you. The money will be shipped by courier to you for us to share in the ratio of 80% for me and my clients and 20% for you. I hope that is okay.     ","concept_score_orig":0.0,"text":"URGENT RESPONSE NEEDED URGENT RESPONSE NEEDEDFROM: BRIAN Smithies friend, I am Brian Smith Esq, my client is one of the top Managers of Midland Bank London Branch and his colleague in the same bank here in the United Kingdom have an urgent and very confidential business proposition for you. On June 6th, 2001, a Chinese businessman, Mr. CHOW LIU, deposited in his personal safety deposit vault currency valued at £17,500,000.00 (Seventeen Million, Five Hundred Thousand British Pound Sterling) in my client's branch. Upon expiration of the period of leasehold of his safety deposit vault two years ago, my client sent a routine notification to his forwarding address but got no reply. Some months ago, a reminder was sent, and finally it was discovered he had passed away. On further investigation, it was discovered that he did not leave a WILL and all attempts to trace his next of kin were fruitless. Further investigations revealed that Mr. CHOW LIU did not declare any next-of- kin in all his official documents in my clients' bank. This sum of £17,500,000.00 is still in the Vault which was opened, and the keys changed upon the expiration of the period of leasehold by my clients. Consequently, my proposal is that my clients will like you as a foreigner to stand in as the next of kin to Mr. CHOW LIU. This is simple. I will like you to provide me immediately with your full names and address so that by virtue of my position as an attorney, I will prepare the necessary documents and affidavits, which will put you in place as the next of kin. I shall do the drafting and notarization of the WILL and obtain the necessary documents and letter of probate/administration in your favor from the shipment of the funds through a courier company to you. The money will be shipped by courier to you for us to share in the ratio of 80% for me and my clients and 20% for you. I hope that is okay. If you are interested, please reply immediately via email:- brian_smith650@hotmail.com If on the other hand you are not interested please disregard this mail and I will not contact you again. Protecting the security of your account and of the Washington Mutual network is our primary concern. Therefore, as a preventative measure, we have temporarily limited access to sensitive account features. To restore your account access, please take the following steps to ensure that your account has not been compromised: 1. Login to your Washington Mutual Internet Banking account. In case you are not enrolled yet for Internet Banking, you will have to use your Social Security Number as both your Personal ID and Password and fill in the required information, including your name and account number. 2. Review your recent account history for any unauthorized withdrawals or deposits, and check your account profile to make sure no changes have been made. If any unauthorized activity has taken place on your account, report to Washington Mutual staff immediately. To get started, please click the link below: https://online.wamu.com/IdentityManagement/Logon.aspx We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and appreciate your assistance in helping us maintain the integrity of the entire Washington Mutual system.     ","concept_score_orig":0.0,"text":"URGENT RESPONSE NEEDED URGENT RESPONSE NEEDEDFROM: BRIAN Smithies friend, I am Brian Smith Esq, my client is one of the top Managers of Midland Bank London Branch and his colleague in the same bank here in the United Kingdom have an urgent and very confidential business proposition for you. On June 6th, 2001, a Chinese businessman, Mr. CHOW LIU, deposited in his personal safety deposit vault currency valued at £17,500,000.00 (Seventeen Million, Five Hundred Thousand British Pound Sterling) in my client's branch. Upon expiration of the period of leasehold of his safety deposit vault two years ago, my client sent a routine notification to his forwarding address but got no reply. Some months ago, a reminder was sent, and finally it was discovered he had passed away. On further investigation, it was discovered that he did not leave a WILL and all attempts to trace his next of kin were fruitless. Further investigations revealed that Mr. CHOW LIU did not declare any next-of- kin in all his official documents in my clients' bank. This sum of £17,500,000.00 is still in the Vault which was opened, and the keys changed upon the expiration of the period of leasehold by my clients. Consequently, my proposal is that my clients will like you as a foreigner to stand in as the next of kin to Mr. CHOW LIU. This is simple. I will like you to provide me immediately with your full names and address so that by virtue of my position as an attorney, I will prepare the necessary documents and affidavits, which will put you in place as the next of kin. Protecting the security of your account and of the Washington Mutual network is our primary concern. Therefore, as a preventative measure, we have temporarily limited access to sensitive account features. To restore your account access, please take the following steps to ensure that your account has not been compromised: 1. Login to your Washington Mutual Internet Banking account. In case you are not enrolled yet for Internet Banking, you will have to use your Social Security Number as both your Personal ID and Password and fill in the required information, including your name and account number. 2. Review your recent account history for any unauthorized withdrawals or deposits, and check your account profile to make sure no changes have been made. If any unauthorized activity has taken place on your account, report to Washington Mutual staff immediately. Upon expiration of the period of leasehold of his safety deposit vault two years ago, my client sent a routine notification to his forwarding address but got no reply. Some months ago, a reminder was sent, and finally it was discovered he had passed away. On further investigation, it was discovered that he did not leave a WILL and all attempts to trace his next of kin were fruitless. Further investigations revealed that Mr. CHOW LIU did not declare any next-of- kin in all his official documents in my clients' bank. This sum of £17,500,000.00 is still in the Vault which was opened, and the keys changed upon the expiration of the period of leasehold by my clients. Upon expiration of the period of leasehold of his safety deposit vault two years ago, my client sent a routine notification to his forwarding address but got no reply. On further investigation, it was discovered that he did not leave a WILL and all attempts to trace his next of kin were fruitless. This sum of £17,500,000.00 is still in the Vault which was opened, and the keys changed upon the expiration of the period of leasehold by my clients. I will like you to provide me immediately with your full names and address so that by virtue of my position as an attorney, I will prepare the necessary documents and affidavits, which will put you in place as the next of kin. I shall do the drafting and notarization of the WILL and obtain the necessary documents and letter of probate/administration in your favor from the shipment of the funds through a courier company to you. Protecting the security of your account and of the Washington Mutual network is our primary concern. Therefore, as a preventative measure, we have temporarily limited access to sensitive account features. To restore your account access, please take the following steps to ensure that your account has not been compromised: 1. Login to your Washington Mutual Internet Banking account. In case you are not enrolled yet for Internet Banking, you will have to use your Social Security Number as both your Personal ID and Password and fill in the required information, including your name and account number. 2. Review your recent account history for any unauthorized withdrawals or deposits, and check your account profile to make sure no changes have been made. Upon expiration of the period of leasehold of his safety deposit vault two years ago, my client sent a routine notification to his forwarding address but got no reply. On further investigation, it was discovered that he did not leave a WILL and all attempts to trace his next of kin were fruitless.     ","concept_score_orig":0.0,"text":"URGENT RESPONSE NEEDED URGENT RESPONSE NEEDEDFROM: BRIAN Smithies friend, I am Brian Smith Esq, my client is one of the top Managers of Midland Bank London Branch and his colleague in the same bank here in the United Kingdom have an urgent and very confidential business proposition for you. On June 6th, 2001, a Chinese businessman, Mr. CHOW LIU, deposited in his personal safety deposit vault currency valued at £17,500,000.00 (Seventeen Million, Five Hundred Thousand British Pound Sterling) in my client's branch. Upon expiration of the period of leasehold of his safety deposit vault two years ago, my client sent a routine notification to his forwarding address but got no reply. Some months ago, a reminder was sent, and finally it was discovered he had passed away. On further investigation, it was discovered that he did not leave a WILL and all attempts to trace his next of kin were fruitless. Further investigations revealed that Mr. CHOW LIU did not declare any next-of- kin in all his official documents in my clients' bank. This sum of £17,500,000.00 is still in the Vault which was opened, and the keys changed upon the expiration of the period of leasehold by my clients. Consequently, my proposal is that my clients will like you as a foreigner to stand in as the next of kin to Mr. CHOW LIU. This is simple. I will like you to provide me immediately with your full names and address so that by virtue of my position as an attorney, I will prepare the necessary documents and affidavits, which will put you in place as the next of kin. I shall do the drafting and notarization of the WILL and obtain the necessary documents and letter of probate/administration in your favor from the shipment of the funds through a courier company to you.
